reports.title: nLIGHT, Inc. Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results

guidance.heading: Outlook
section: For the fourth quarter of 2026, nLIGHT expects revenues to be in the range of $84 million to $90 million. The midpoint of $87 million includes Products revenue of approximately $63 million and Advanced Development revenue of approximately $24 million. Due to ongoing supply chain constraints, nLIGHT’s fourth quarter revenue guidance excludes approximately $15 million of product revenue that nLIGHT would have expected to ship in the fourth quarter but is now expected to be delivered in the first half of 2027.

nLIGHT expects overall gross margin to be in the range of 30% to 36%, with Products gross margin in the range of 40% to 46% and Advanced Development gross margin of approximately 8%. nLIGHT expects Adjusted EBITDA to be in the range of $12 million to $18 million.
Investor Webcast at 2:00 p.m. Pacific Time, Thursday, November 5, 2026

A webcast to discuss the third quarter results will be held on Thursday, November 5, 2026, at 2:00 p.m. Pacific Time (5:00 p.m. Eastern Time). The audio webcast will be available on the investor relations section of the company's web site at http://investors.nlight.net. A replay of the webcast will be available shortly after the conclusion of the call.
The webcast can also be accessed directly at https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/340012307.
